South Dakota's Artsy Festival Within Custer State Park Serves Old West Charm, Buffalo, And Renowned Views
By Kristin Conard,
2 hours agoIt's not so often that you can feel the ground shake beneath your feet as hundreds of bison make their way past you, but it's something you can experience each year in Custer State Park, one of the Midwest's most underrated parks. The annual Buffalo Roundup and Arts Festival brings nearly 25,000 visitors to watch the spectacle, where approximately 1,500 bison are rounded up and brought together to corrals near the Custer State Park Bison Center. It's a free event, held the last weekend of September; 2025's roundup on September 26 is the 60th one. And the accompanying arts festival, with upwards of 150 vendors, is on September 25 to 27.
